name: UpCloud Managed Object Storage
tax_note: Taxes doc: VAT is charged in the EU according to the customer's country (Finnish VAT for Finnish companies; VAT-registered EU businesses can buy VAT-free); 7% GST for Singapore consumers; others are not charged tax. Whether list prices include VAT could not be read from the pricing page. Source: https://upcloud.com/docs/getting-started/billing/taxes/

storage_classes.name: Managed Object Storage

capacity_gb.note: Billing doc: billing is based on storage usage in increments of 250 GB, each increment billed per hour; new instances are deployed with 250 GB (minimum invoicing unit) and scale up automatically by 250 GB.

monthly_price.note: Not verified: the pricing page (https://upcloud.com/pricing/) and product page return HTTP 403 / a bot challenge to non-browser clients, the price API (https://api.upcloud.com/1.3/price) requires authentication, and the billing doc only refers to the pricing pages. The official calculator (calc.upcloud.com) embeds 'managed_object_storage_250GB' price 0.6944 for every location, but its unit (presumably per hour, in an unstated currency unit) is not stated, so no value is recorded.

put_per_1000.note: The billing doc says Managed Object Storage 'is billed based on the amount of storage you use' and lists no request fees, but does not state that requests are free; the pricing page could not be read (HTTP 403 / bot challenge).

get_per_1000.note: The billing doc says Managed Object Storage 'is billed based on the amount of storage you use' and lists no request fees, but does not state that requests are free; the pricing page could not be read (HTTP 403 / bot challenge).

list_per_1000.note: The billing doc says Managed Object Storage 'is billed based on the amount of storage you use' and lists no request fees, but does not state that requests are free; the pricing page could not be read (HTTP 403 / bot challenge).

price_per_gb.note: No retrieval fee line in the billing doc; single hot class. Absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

typical_delay.note: Not applicable (hot storage); no delay stated.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Not stated in the billing doc; billing is per hour per 250 GB increment.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated in the docs checked.

notes: Billed per started 250 GB increment per hour; the instance scales up automatically (billing and scalable-bucket-size docs).
Prices must be filled in from https://upcloud.com/pricing/ with a browser before this profile is used in estimates.

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: No fixed allowance: the billing doc states zero-cost egress for Managed Object Storage (no per-GB charge at all); see egress_fair_use.

egress.free_allowance_scope: Egress is not charged; Fair Transfer Policy may throttle high-bandwidth use.

price.note: Billing doc 'Zero egress fees': 'All our public cloud services, including Managed Object Storage, now include zero-cost egress transfer. This means that you will not be charged for any outbound network transfer costs'.

notes: Ingress, Utility network and SDN private network transfer are included (network transfer doc).

egress_fair_use.value: Fair Transfer Policy: the included public egress (Fair Transfer Limit) is calculated from the cloud resources on the account; when it is reached UpCloud sends a warning and may throttle bandwidth to 100 Mbit/s. The doc lists only Cloud Server plans as contributing, not Object Storage.
egress_fair_use.note: The object storage billing doc points to the Fair Transfer Policy; how a storage-only account's limit is computed is not stated.

free_tier.value: Free trial: 7 days from activation for new users, including 1 Managed Object Storage instance of 250 GB.
free_tier.note: Trial only, not a permanent free tier; requires card verification.

object_lock.note: S3 compatibility doc lists 'Object lock (Coming soon): Bucket Object Lock configuration'; not available as of the check.

s3_endpoints.label: Helsinki
s3_endpoints.note: Endpoints are per Object Storage instance (docs example https://abcd1.upcloudobjects.com; replace with the endpoint shown in the Control Panel). The s3cmd guide configures the DNS-style template %(bucket)s.<s3-endpoint>, i.e. virtual-hosted style. Signing region per the get-started guide example (region=europe-1).
